selected_scope: Global polygons and all attributes for 1,427,688 lakes/reservoirs, using the HydroLAKES v1.0 shapefile download. The community GEE entry also exposes a separate point layer, not included in this polygon size.
native_formats: File geodatabase in ZIP archive (polygon layer)

download_size.scope: Global HydroLAKES v1 polygon shapefile, including all attributes
download_size.basis: HydroSHEDS producer page states lake polygons in shapefile format are 820 MB. This is not the geodatabase package, pour-point layer, or both-layer total.

alternative_sizes.scope: Same global HydroLAKES v1 polygon data and attributes in geodatabase format
alternative_sizes.basis: HydroSHEDS producer page lists separate geodatabase polygon package.

alternative_sizes.display: 79 MB ZIP shapefile; 81 MB ZIP geodatabase
alternative_sizes.scope: Separate global lake pour-point layer
alternative_sizes.basis: HydroSHEDS producer page lists pour points separately; not included in selected polygon size.

rationale: Lake boundaries and descriptive attributes are vector data. GeoParquet suits analytical joins/filtering and PMTiles can serve visualization while keeping the full polygons and attributes in the analytical release.
existing_cloud_native: Earth Engine FeatureCollections for lake polygons and points are verified; no public cloud object distribution in a columnar vector format was verified.
caveats: Four distinct producer downloads exist: polygon/point crossed with shapefile/geodatabase; never conflate their sizes.
HydroLAKES v1 includes lakes >=10 ha and about 1.4 million lakes/reservoirs; community catalog exposes both polygon and point collections.

sources.supports: Producer-published v1 polygon and point distribution formats and sizes.
Community GEE membership, separate polygon/point layers and 1,427,688 feature scope.
HydroLAKES v1 technical documentation and shapefile composition.

label: MapBiomas land cover family (Collection 9 community page; Brazil V1 official GEE asset)
selected_scope: The community entry is a multi-country, multi-product family and explicitly expands beyond Brazil to Pan-Amazonia, Indonesia, Bolivia, Peru and other regions. Size scope is narrowed to MapBiomas Brazil Collection 9 annual land-cover maps, 1985–2023; no full family total. The separate official GEE Brazil V1 collection is a different catalog asset/vintage (1985–2024), not the same dataset as Collection 9.
native_formats: GeoTIFF for pixel classification maps, including producer-generated regional/geometry subsets
CSV or Excel for area statistics

download_size.scope: Brazil Collection 9 annual LULC maps, 1985–2023, as full-resolution 30 m producer-distributed GeoTIFF maps; excludes stats, other MapBiomas regions/products, and official GEE Brazil V1
download_size.basis: MapBiomas provides no complete Collection 9 byte manifest on checked producer pages; its current full-map GeoTIFF download function is temporarily suspended. Its toolkit exports clips through GEE, which does not provide a producer size for the global annual Collection 9 maps.

desired_formats: COG for annual categorical map rasters
Zarr only for explicitly packaged multi-year categorical time stacks, preserving class codes and year coordinate
rationale: Annual land-cover classifications are categorical raster maps and fit COG. Zarr is an optional temporal stack for multi-year operations; preserve integer class values, legend version, year, region, scale and nodata exactly.
existing_cloud_native: Community/official Earth Engine assets exist; producer's current toolkit exports clipped GeoTIFF through GEE. No public cloud-native COG/Zarr Collection 9 distribution verified.
caveats: Community page's inline example is Collection 8 and its changelog says catalog links updated to v8; it describes a broad family, not a current Collection 9-only raster identity.

The producer FAQ states Collection 9 covers 1985–2023 and Collection 10 (released 2025) covers 1985–2024. The current Brazil export toolkit lists Collection 11, while the full-map GeoTIFF function is temporarily suspended.
Official Earth Engine projects/mapbiomas-public/assets/brazil/lulc/v1 is distinct and cataloged for 1985–2024; do not use its coverage or version to label Collection 9 or vice versa.

sources.supports: Community family includes Brazil plus multiple regions, multi-raster scope, and stale Collection 8 code/changelog.
Producer lists annual GeoTIFF downloads, GEE assets, clipped exports and statistics resources; linked full-map page is stale/404.
Producer says full-map downloads are temporarily suspended and its clipped export toolkit requires GEE; current toolkit lists Collection 11 and historical collections.
Producer-published Collection 9 1985–2023 and Collection 10 1985–2024 version coverage; GeoTIFF/CSV/Excel formats.
Separate official Brazil V1 ImageCollection identity and 1985–2024 coverage.

label: MERIT DEM v1.0.3
selected_scope: One static global land elevation product at 3-arc-second (~90 m) resolution, covering 60°S–90°N, in the official Earth Engine catalog. Producer files are 5° x 5° GeoTIFF tiles bundled into 30° x 30° TAR packages.

download_size.scope: Global MERIT DEM v1.0.3 tiled producer download, 3 arc-seconds, 60°S–90°N
download_size.basis: The producer documents tile/package format and says a password is issued after registration, but no public file-size manifest was found without following the registration-gated download. No account was created and no data files were fetched.

alternative_sizes.display: 311.04 GB uncompressed rectangular-grid payload (calculated upper envelope; not download size)
alternative_sizes.scope: Rectangular 3-arc-second grid envelope covering 360° longitude by 150° latitude, one Float32 elevation value per cell, before NoData omission, headers, tiling or compression
alternative_sizes.basis: 432,000 longitude cells (360×1,200) × 180,000 latitude cells (150×1,200) × 4 bytes/Float32 = 311,040,000,000 bytes = 311.04 decimal GB. This is a rectangular payload calculation, not a measured archive or the sum of land-only tiles.

rationale: A static elevation surface is suited to tiled COG range access. Preserve EGM96-referenced elevation, original grid alignment, NoData and license metadata.
existing_cloud_native: Earth Engine hosted image is verified; no public open cloud COG tile distribution verified. Producer download is tiled GeoTIFF/TAR and requires registration-issued password.
caveats: The producer page states access password is issued by email after registration; registration was not attempted.
The calculated 311.04 GB is an uncompressed rectangular grid envelope with ocean/NoData slots, not an observed download total.
Official catalog specifies approximately 92.77 m pixels in the dataset metadata and extent -60,-180,90,180; geographic resolution is 3 arc-seconds (~90 m at equator).
Producer explicitly requires written permission to redistribute the complete original dataset on another website. Desired COG is a technical target; a public mirror needs a separate rights review.

sources.supports: Producer documentation of v1.0.3, Float32 GeoTIFF 5° tiles, 30° TAR packages, and registration/password-gated access.
Official GEE asset scope, 3-arc-second resolution, pixel size, band and geographic extent.
